title: Captured German nuclear scientists wiretapped in an English country house

tellings.quote: program. What's interesting about him is he and all the people on his nuclear program were captured like you said and they were put I believe in the English countryside and they the whole house was wiretapped

plain: At the end of the Second World War in 1945, the physicist Werner Heisenberg and the others on Germany's nuclear program were captured and held in a country house in England, and the whole house was secretly wiretapped. Michels tells this himself, saying he "believe[s]" that is where they were kept, and points to the transcripts of those recordings. It is told because the secretly recorded talk would show what the German scientists really knew.
